intro: Skinning takes leather and hides from the beasts you kill. Leatherworking turns them into armour, so the two go well together.

Ranks: Apprentice at any level; Journeyman from skill 50, Expert from 125 and Artisan from 200, at the trainers in the capitals and the larger towns. The trainers in the starting areas teach only up to 75. On Zephras Isle the quest Harvesting Windstones offers Pelt Collecting for Beginners, which teaches Skinning.

A beast needs Skinning skill 1 up to level 10, 10 more for every level from 11 to 19 (level 15 needs 50), and five times its level from 20 (level 30 needs 150). Enchant Gloves - Skinning lets you skin beasts a level higher; Horde players can take the Keen Skinning Knife (+3) from Unwelcome Guests in The Barrens.
